REST control plane for the 100ms live video and audio platform. Manage rooms, templates and roles (policy), active in-session control, recordings, live streams (HLS), external streams (RTMP push to YouTube/Twitch/Facebook), RTMP stream keys, room codes, polls, sessions, and analytics. All endpoints are authenticated with a short-lived management JWT signed with the app access key/secret pair from the dashboard.
